title: Thermal 80mm Slip & A4 Tax Invoice Printing

intro.title: Thermal 80mm Slip & A4 Tax Invoice
intro.subtitle: High-speed counter thermal receipts, regulatory A4 GST tax invoices, and dual print formatting

narration.text: Welcome to Phase 2, Part 14: Thermal 80mm Slip and A4 Tax Invoice Printing. In this final counter mastery tutorial, learn how to instantly issue clean customer receipts and regulatory tax invoices.
Open any completed invoice from the sales ledger or immediately after checkout. MediFlow loads the dedicated print preview page.

The 80mm Thermal Slip format is optimized for high-speed counter thermal printers like TVS and Epson. It includes store drug licenses, GSTIN, itemized batches, expiry dates, and clean payment breakdown.
Click Full A4 GST Invoice to switch to statutory format. This layout displays detailed tax tables with CGST, SGST, HSN codes, and digital signature boxes for corporate or insurance billing.
Click Print or press Ctrl + P to output directly. Congratulations on mastering Phase 2! In Phase 3, we dive into Drug Compliance and Prescription Regulations.

outro.takeaway: Invoice Printing: Seamlessly toggle between fast 80mm thermal counter slips and formal A4 GST tax invoices with full statutory compliance.
